digest.component_or_area: lint and type-check quality gate orchestration
propositions: Approved maintainability and type-check ratchets cannot be enabled without first addressing existing diagnostics in the codebase.

Function complexity (C901), four Mypy settings (no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores), and Ruff rules (ASYNC, DTZ, RUF hygiene) must be staged and enforced through a feature branch merge workflow with independent per-story verification.
pyproject.toml edits must execute in a fixed dependency order: d9f5 baseline, then 28cd with shared test creation, then 125d extending tests.
All child stories must merge with Gerrit LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and zero unresolved comments before atomic merge-back to main.
